research_notes: Initial research2026-10-01. Searched APH, WA nomination Hansard, both first speeches, Woodside article/Trunkline, own biography, publicly indexed professional material, Pique and JESCO employer pages and interests transcription.

SignalHire search lead suggested month-level Pique/JESCO roles but is an aggregator, not a verified self-authored profile; those dates not adopted. No contact details collected. JESCO role independently confirmed by employer.

Follow-up: historical company biographies/annual reports for Pique and JESCO dates/pay/hours, Farstad employing entity and2017 restructuring, cadet training/leave, business-owner workload and cessation, original parliamentary interests declarations, and overlaps2022–25. Government-control classifications reflect commercial corporations; verify precise legal employers.
First-entry cutoff25November2020; later commercial work retained as separate inter-parliamentary evidence, not silently added to pre-entry experience. No unsupported public-sector zero.

Follow-up 2026-10-02: original Pique capability statement independently confirms director role, identifies two hospitality ventures and retained interests; live website supplies the Australian legal entity. Current team page and undated brochure differ, so no cessation date inferred.

Clime appointment lead unresolved: December 2023 original notice only proposes election; February 2024 syndicated summaries contradict each other on the vote. Listcorp original results link returned 403; indexed voting-results summary says rejected. Do not add a Clime employment/directorship spell from the erroneous-looking approved summary; seek original 2 February 2024 poll table if revisiting.

Source attempts: Leeuwin 2023 financial report returned 404; Pique Capital website inaccessible. Capability PDF search retrieval exceeded size limit (400; 15259658 bytes), recovered through ordinary public download and text extraction; first download script lacked requests, recovered with standard-library urllib. US Pique Partners marketing company is a namesake, excluded. SignalHire even associates Australian profile with that US domain; its detailed month dates remain unverified discovery leads.

Remaining follow-up: maritime contracts, cadet training versus service/leave, Farstad legal employer/restructure, Pique/JESCO appointment and exit, second hospitality business identity and own workload; Leeuwin governance dates. Generic current BP cadet programme conditions cannot establish Small’s 2006 terms.
